body:
SWORD II session update (2026-08-26, continuing overnight autonomous run per your "don't stop" instruction):

Cycle 7 finished: 8th run overall, STAND DOWN/NO-EDGE this time (not OVERFIT -- 2/6 gates, WR 23.1%, E[R] -0.51R). Real variation vs the prior 6 identical-looking cycles, consistent with genuine small-sample OOS noise, not a code bug.

Restarted onto the WARRANT#177 build to run a HISTORICAL score/outcome export (no live trade needed) -- confirmed created: 50,000 rows, 42,772 resolved. Built and self-tested a new analyzer (IC/AUC), and ran the actual "single most informative test" (Part VI.1-R3) at n=42,772 -- 14x the power floor:

  IC(|score|, won) = -0.0024
  AUC(|score| -> won) = 0.4986

Both essentially null. This CONFIRMS, at far higher statistical power than 7 live cycles combined, that the blended score genuinely lacks discriminative power over this window -- same diagnosis Phase 1 kept reaching live, now nailed down with a real well-powered test instead of repeated small-sample restarts.

Shipped WARRANT#179 on top: added a regime tag to the same historical export (reusing the live regime classifier), so a per-regime breakdown can be checked against WARRANT#176's live finding (Strong Bear signal inversion, real n>=500). Compiled clean, deployed to all 3 locations, safe while cycle 8 (already running) continues -- restart deferred until it reaches STAND DOWN naturally.

Cycle 8 is running now. Continuing the loop per your instructions: fix -> restart -> observe -> confirm/refute -> fix again, with dead-end/stall detection active. Will report again at the next real milestone.
